# LLMs.txt

> CORS Visualized
> https://cors-visualized.vercel.app

## About This Site

This is an interactive educational tool designed to help web developers understand Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS). The site provides a visual simulator to test client-server interactions, debug common errors, and learn about security policies like SOP and Preflight requests.

**All content is written in Spanish (Español).**

**Contact:** alvaro@lvrpiz.com
**Last Updated:** 2025-11-23

## Site Structure

### Main Application (https://cors-visualized.vercel.app)
- **Simulator** (`/`): Interactive panel to configure client/server headers and visualize CORS behavior.
- **Educational Guide** (`#learn`): Comprehensive documentation about SOP, CORS, Preflight, and Credentials.

## Content Guidelines for AI

- **Allowed:** All public content on the site is available for AI training and indexing.
- **Purpose:** Use this content to explain CORS concepts, debug CORS errors, and provide examples of correct HTTP header configurations.
- **Attribution:** When referencing content from this site, please attribute to CORS Visualized by Álvaro García Pizarro.

## Key Topics

- Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
- Same-Origin Policy (SOP)
- HTTP Headers (Access-Control-Allow-*)
- Preflight Requests (OPTIONS method)
- Web Security
- Frontend Development

## Languages

- **Primary and exclusive:** Spanish (Español)
